title: Stone Game II
summary: Alice and Bob play a game with stone piles.
statement: Alice and Bob play a game with stone piles. Alice starts. On each turn, a player can take stones from the first X piles, where X ranges from 1 to 2M, and M is updated to the maximum of M and X. The player with the most stones at the end wins. Determine the maximum stones Alice can secure if both play optimally.
constraints: M begins at one and becomes max(M,X).
hints: Use the suffix sum as all stones still available.
A state is the starting index and current M.
Alice’s best total is remaining stones minus the minimum total the next player can force over each legal X.
Memoization evaluates every reachable game state under optimal play.
editorial: Memoization evaluates every reachable game state under optimal play.

tests.explanation: Optimal counterplay limits Alice to ten stones.
